newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end slightly up on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end slightly up on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended slightly higher on Tuesday as rises in select blue chips offset position-squaring on settlement day, dealers said.
"The index rebounded as the market was oversold," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said. "Select blue chips gained on technical buying which is likely to continue in the next few sessions."
But dealers said sentiment was weak because Pakistan's weak economic fundamentals were still deterring investors.
The Karachi index rose 1.24 points, or 0.08 percent, to end at 1,533.05. Losers led gainers 185 to 59. Turnover rose to 59.47 million shares from 56.96 in the previous session.
Hub Power rose 0.30 rupee to 37.45, PTCL 1.0 to 24.65 and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 23.75.
